LESSON: MASS (HEAVY AND LIGHT)

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Measurement
Topic 3.2: Mass (Heavy and Light)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Mass (Heavy and Light), part of Measurement in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: How can you tell the object is heavy/light?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: learners lift heavy and light concrete objects and learn that they have different mass (heavy/light).

Values:
Unity: learners harmoniously work jointly with each other and take turns in lifting concrete objects.

Safety: learners carefully play games involving lifting of heavy and light objects.
